# Tuned by Keith

> Custom ECU tuning by Keith Fields, operating as Calibrations LLC. Subaru WRX/STI e-tuning, Porsche calibration, Ford Focus/Fiesta/Raptor tuning, standalone ECU projects, and coordinated road, dyno and travel tuning.

Official website: https://www.tunedbykeith.com/
Contact: keith@tunedbykeith.com | +1-714-367-4201.
Keith has calibration experience dating to 2005. Remote service availability depends on the vehicle, ECU, fuel, hardware and logging equipment. Orange County, California in-person sessions require prior coordination; road tuning may require the car for the day. A customer-arranged dyno can also be discussed.

The linked public pages provide current service details, prices, compatibility considerations and policies. Build results describe individual vehicles and test conditions, not guaranteed output for another car. Historical configurations and later upgrades are separate stages. Inquiry forms are available without payment. This guide covers public information, not private order pages or customer files.

## Services and getting started

- [Service menu and inquiries](https://www.tunedbykeith.com/shop.html): Current services, prices and a no-payment inquiry path.
- [Subaru WRX and STI tuning](https://www.tunedbykeith.com/subaru-wrx-sti-tuning.html): Vehicle selection, process, results and Subaru inquiries.
- [EJ WRX and STI e-tuning](https://www.tunedbykeith.com/ej-wrx-sti-etuning.html): 2002–2014 WRX and 2004–2021 STI setup and logging considerations.
- [2015–2021 WRX e-tuning](https://www.tunedbykeith.com/2015-2021-wrx-etuning.html): FA20 WRX service details.
- [2022+ WRX e-tuning](https://www.tunedbykeith.com/2022-plus-wrx-etuning.html): FA24 WRX service details; exact ECU support is confirmed individually.
- [Porsche tuning](https://www.tunedbykeith.com/porsche-tuning.html): Supported modern COBB applications and vintage engine projects.
- [Ford Focus, Fiesta and Raptor tuning](https://www.tunedbykeith.com/ford-tuning.html): Exact-model compatibility, equipment, fuel, logging and inquiry guidance.
- [Infiniti Q50 and Q60 tuning](https://www.tunedbykeith.com/infiniti-q50-q60-tuning.html): VR30 3.0t and Red Sport setup review, EcuTek equipment, fuel and preparation.
- [Standalone ECU tuning](https://www.tunedbykeith.com/standalone-ecu-tuning.html): ECU selection, project scope and calibration support.
- [COBB custom tuning](https://www.tunedbykeith.com/cobb-custom-tuning.html): Vehicle-specific compatibility and service options.
- [EcuTek BRZ and GR86 tuning](https://www.tunedbykeith.com/ecutek-brz-tuning.html): First- and second-generation platform considerations.
- [Orange County tuning](https://www.tunedbykeith.com/orange-county-porsche-subaru-tuning.html): Coordinated Subaru and Porsche road or dyno sessions.
- [Dyno and travel tuning](https://www.tunedbykeith.com/dyno-tuning/): Session planning and facility coordination.

## Experience and build evidence

- [About Keith Fields](https://www.tunedbykeith.com/about-keith-fields.html): Background, AWD Tuning history and source references.
- [Porsche 911 Turbo S COBB results](https://www.tunedbykeith.com/porsche-911-turbo-s-cobb-results.html): Documented Porsche tuning examples.

- [Keith's white 2015 STI](https://www.tunedbykeith.com/keith-2015-sti.html): Personal build, Precision 6466 stage and historical development.
- [Lucas's 2018 STI Emtron build](https://www.tunedbykeith.com/lucas-2018-sti-emtron.html): Build story, dated results and original media.
- [Cinderelli 2024 WRX](https://www.tunedbykeith.com/2024-wrx-cinderelli-e70.html): Configuration-specific WRX results.
- [2019 STI BCP turbo on 93 octane](https://www.tunedbykeith.com/2019-sti-bcp-turbo-93-octane.html): A documented STI tuning example.
- [Jaycee’s 2017 Focus RS](https://www.tunedbykeith.com/jaycee-2017-focus-rs-build.html): Confirmed AWD build photo and dated 2022–2024 dyno records; corrected and uncorrected figures distinguished.
- [Chris’s 2020 STI](https://www.tunedbykeith.com/chris-2020-sti-flex-fuel.html): Stock-turbo, bolt-on flex-fuel build with customer video and pump-gas/E75 records.
- [Chris’s 2016 WRX](https://www.tunedbykeith.com/chris-2016-wrx-fa20-build.html): IAG shortblock, Kelford cams and dated FA20 development records.
- [Mary’s 2018 Infiniti Q60 Red Sport](https://www.tunedbykeith.com/mary-2018-infiniti-q60-red-sport.html): Original photos, dyno footage and the January 2021 individual report.
- [David’s 2004 STI](https://www.tunedbykeith.com/david-2004-sti-link-build.html): Link flex-fuel build, original videos and separately dated 93-octane/E75 records.
- [Thomas’s 2004 STI](https://www.tunedbykeith.com/thomas-2004-sti-haltech-build.html): Haltech build with original workshop media and dated dyno records.
- [Thomas’s HKS turbo GR86](https://www.tunedbykeith.com/thomas-2024-gr86-hks-turbo.html): EcuTek/HKS project, photos and original February 2025 report.
- [Build examples](https://www.tunedbykeith.com/build-examples.html): Historical projects with source context and calibration lessons.
- [Builds, dyno sheets and videos](https://www.tunedbykeith.com/media.html): Public media with build context.

## Tuning equipment and how-to guides

- [Tuning knowledge](https://www.tunedbykeith.com/tuning-knowledge.html): Equipment, preparation and ECU guide directory.
- [Accessport flashing and datalogging](https://www.tunedbykeith.com/accessport-flashing-datalogging-guide.html): Customer instructions and Subaru platform-specific logging lists; EJ remote tuning requires an external wideband and an approved recorded AFR/lambda data path.
- [COBB Accessport](https://www.tunedbykeith.com/knowledge/cobb-accessport.html): Handheld hardware, compatibility, file transfer and logging.
- [EcuTek](https://www.tunedbykeith.com/knowledge/ecutek.html): Programming routes, licences and ECU Connect hardware.
- [Open-source Subaru tools](https://www.tunedbykeith.com/knowledge/open-source.html): EcuFlash, RomRaider, ROM definitions and interface considerations.
- [Emtron](https://www.tunedbykeith.com/knowledge/emtron.html): Standalone hardware, software and project preparation.
- [Haltech](https://www.tunedbykeith.com/knowledge/haltech.html): ECU generation, NSP/ESP software and setup information.
- [Link ECU](https://www.tunedbykeith.com/knowledge/link-ecu.html): Plug-in/wire-in hardware, PCLink and logs.
- [MoTeC](https://www.tunedbykeith.com/knowledge/motec.html): ECU model, M1 package and logging requirements.
- [MaxxECU](https://www.tunedbykeith.com/knowledge/maxxecu.html): ECU hardware, MTune and original log files.
